events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: The Falcons couldn't follow through with their plan to gain momentum for the playoffs as Josh Freeman threw a touchdown pass to Mike Williams, Doug Martin ran for 141 yards and the Tampa Bay Buccaneers beat Atlanta 22-17 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Falcons' Abraham, Robinson injured in loss

events.name: New York Jets at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: C.J. Spiller scored on a 66-yard catch and run in helping the under-achieving Buffalo Bills end their season with a 28-9 win over the New York Jets on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Spiller, Bills finish season with romp over Jets

headlines.description: Carlos Dunlap returned an interception 14 yards for a touchdown in the fourth quarter Sunday, sending the Cincinnati Bengals to a 23-17 victory over the Baltimore Ravens in a game that didn't much matter to either playoff-bound team.
headlines.shortLinkText: Playoff-bound Bengals finish strong vs. Ravens

headlines.description: The Chicago Bears held on against Detroit -- before their playoff hopes faded away for good.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bears hold off Lions, eliminated from playoffs

headlines.description: Tennessee became the first team in NFL history with two players scoring twice on returns in a game as the Titans beat the Jacksonville Jaguars 38-20 Sunday in their season finale.
headlines.shortLinkText: Titans make history with return TDs, top Jags

headlines.description: Deji Karim swung the game with a 101-yard kickoff return in the third quarter, giving the Colts a 28-16 victory over the Texans in coach Chuck Pagano's first game back as coach since starting treatment for leukemia Sept. 26.
headlines.shortLinkText: Colts sink skidding Texans in Pagano's return

events.name: Carolina Panthers at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Drew Brees made more NFL history, but so did the Saints' defense in an undesirable way, and the Carolina Panthers rallied to a 44-38 victory Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brees makes history, so does Saints' D in loss

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at New York Giants

headlines.description: There will be no repeat for the New York Giants. Not even a playoff berth.
headlines.shortLinkText: Giants eliminated from playoffs despite blowout

headlines.description: Ben Roethlisberger threw three short touchdown passes, and the Pittsburgh Steelers avoided their first losing season in nearly a decade with a 24-10 victory over the Cleveland Browns on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Big Ben helps Steelers avoid losing season

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: Peyton Manning threw for 304 yards and three touchdowns Sunday to lift Denver to a 38-3 win over Kansas City that sealed the No. 1 seed in the AFC playoffs for the Broncos.
headlines.shortLinkText: Broncos grab top seed; Chiefs get 1st pick

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Minnesota Vikings

headlines.description: Adrian Peterson came within 9 yards of Eric Dickerson's rushing record on Sunday, finishing with 199 yards and powering the Minnesota Vikings into the playoffs, 37-34 over Green Bay.
headlines.shortLinkText: Peterson powers surging Vikes into postseason

events.name: Miami Dolphins at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw two touchdown passes and the New England Patriots regained their dominance after a rare slump, earning a playoff bye with a 28-0 win over the Miami Dolphins on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady, Pats blank Dolphins to earn playoff bye

events.name: Oakland Raiders at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Micheal Spurlock returned the opening kickoff 99 yards for a touchdown and San Diego beat the Raiders 24-21 on a wet, gloomy Sunday in what's expected to be Norv Turner's final game as Chargers coach.
headlines.shortLinkText: Turner expects to be dismissed by Chargers

headlines.description: Michael Crabtree caught touchdown passes of 49 and 7 yards and finished with a career-high 172 yards, leading the San Francisco 49ers to a second straight NFC West title with a 27-13 victory over the Arizona Cardinals on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Niners wrap up NFC West behind Crabtree

events.name: St. Louis Rams at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: Russell Wilson tied Peyton Manning's record for most touchdown passes by a rookie with 26, and his 1-yard TD run with 1:39 left gave Seattle a 20-13 win over the St. Louis Rams on Sunday and an 8-0 home mark for the Seahawks.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wilson ties rookie mark as Seahawks prevail

headlines.description: RG III and the Washington Redskins are NFC East champions.
headlines.shortLinkText: Morris, Redskins top Cowboys for NFC East title
